title: Retry an asynchronous operation
description: Invoke operation at most attempts times, where attempts is the total number of attempts rather than the number of retries. Resolve with the first successful value. If every attempt rejects, reject with the last error. Reject immediately without invoking operation when attempts is less than 1. An optional delayMs is the delay between failed attempts and may be zero.
signature: export function retry<T>(operation: () => Promise<T>, attempts: number, delayMs?: number): Promise<T>
